# Review — kebra-nagast-ch106a (Reviewer; two passes)

Severity: major = wrong sense or misread grammar in `l`/`i`; moderate = wrong or misleading label, lemma or parse, unsupported claim, house-rendering break; minor = wording, hedge, tidy-up. `t` was not touched (checked: every `t` and `p` identical to the draft; unit count unchanged). No Dillmann text was available in this review: lemma/root judgments are from grammar and from the known-forms entries, and where they could not be confirmed a (?) was added or kept.

Totals: Pass 1 (units) 1 major, 8 moderate, 11 minor. Pass 2 (gloss) 0 major, 9 moderate, 5 minor. Pass-2 re-check of my own edits: 0 new findings.

## Findings refused

- **ወያድኅነነ root (drafter-flagged).** Checked, no change: the entry already has lemma አድኀነ (causative "save"), root d-ḫ-n, from ድኅነ "be saved"; ኀ in አድኀነ and ኅ in ድኅነ are the same series in different orders (ḫä vs ḫə), not two roots. No ሐነ / ኀደነ involved. ወያድኅን (unit 12) likewise fine.
- "the Word" / "the Spirit" capitalised in unit 3: house convention (አብ = the Father, ወልድ = the Son); left.
- Unit 8 `i` "was said to": kept; the note now discloses the supplied preposition. Changing to "concerning" would be just as unsupported.
- Unit 8 person shift (your → their in `i`): disclosed in the note; kept.
- ንጉሥ "a king", ስሙ "such is his name": acceptable renderings of an elliptical clause.
- Known-form ጣዖት entry says "Greek loan": published entry, outside this part; flagged here only.
- ወልዲ, እደው, ብረከ, ዕንቡዛነ, ይነቡ entries: parses plausible and already hedged; left.
- ሰማዕት/ወልድ etc. broadenings: known entries already cover their use here.
- Unit 13 "Our-mother Zion" vs "from Zion" for እምነ ጽዮን: kept "our mother" (known-forms supports it for Zion; the suffix of ሣረራ is feminine).
